description: On the countertop there’s a round plate with a small toy and a black card on it, a colorful cube behind the plate, a blue container in front, and a yellow egg-shaped item sitting in a small cup to the right. The right hand reaches rightward to the yellow egg, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it left onto the plate, then releases it; the left hand stays resting nearby without touching anything.
